Author: Manzi
Text: @jbops3 $AVGO Calling this “Broadcom lending Anthropic $42B” misses the structure. A financing partner funds the AI racks and leases the compute capacity to Anthropic. Broadcom backstops part of that lease exposure. Separately, if specified conditions are triggered, Anthropic can issue Broadcom up to $42B of convertible promissory notes, dedicated to those lease obligations. So Broadcom is using financing to secure a massive multi-year customer while also negotiating creditor/equity protections around the exposure. That’s very different from simply writing Anthropic a $42B check.
